jobs.description:
Reports to: CEO
Scope: New product - ground-up build, founding engineering seat


Location: Remote, India


Type: Full-time


Experience: 10+ years
About CRMified
Founded in 2011 by Joshua Hoskins, a Salesforce MVP and Hall of Famer, CRMified delivers Salesforce design and development expertise to mid-market and enterprise clients. We specialize in systems integration with a strong referral-based business, a US-based principal team and a talented delivery team in India.


CRMified runs on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) and we're in an intentional growth phase. Alongside our consulting business, we are now building a new product - and this role is the founding engineering seat for that venture.


About This Role
CRMified's CEO is a senior Salesforce technologist with a clear vision for a new product. What he needs is a senior Ruby developer who can be a true thought partner - someone who shapes architecture and product direction with the founder, and then writes the production code to make it real.


This is not a heads-down ticket-execution role and it is not a side gig. It's a full-time, in-seat position for a builder who wants to start a product: high ownership, high ambiguity and a direct line to the founder with no layers in between. You get the upside of building something from zero, backed by the stability of an established, profitable company.


What You'll Own
Product & Technical Direction


Partner directly with the founder on product strategy, technical decisions, and architecture - you are the technical voice in the room.Translate product vision into pragmatic technical plans, challenging assumptions and proposing better paths where you see them.Building & Shipping
Design, build, and ship the core product in Ruby on a modern application stack.Own the full engineering lifecycle: architecture, development, deployment (Heroku), and iteration based on real user feedback.Set the engineering foundations - code standards, CI/CD, tooling - that future hires will build on.AI-Accelerated Development
Apply AI concepts (LLM APIs, agents, retrieval, automation) both inside the product and in your own workflow to accelerate development velocity.Advise the founder on where AI genuinely belongs in the product and where it doesn't.Salesforce Ecosystem Integration
Design integrations with the Salesforce platform where the product requires it, drawing on your understanding of its data model and APIs.What You Bring
10+ years of software development experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Ruby (Rails or comparable frameworks).A track record at well-known brands or products - you've built and shipped software that real users depend on at scale.Working knowledge of the Salesforce ecosystem: its data model, APIs and how modern applications integrate with it.Heroku and modern application stack experience - comfortable owning deployment, infrastructure, and the full stack.Fluency with AI concepts - you actively use AI tooling in your workflow and can reason about where LLMs, agents, and automation belong in a product.A founder-partner mindset: you want to start a product, not maintain one; you're energized by ambiguity and ownership.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with a US-based founder.Bonus Points
Prior experience as an early or founding engineer at a startup or new product line.Experience building on or alongside Salesforce (AppExchange, Heroku Connect, platform APIs).Experience integrating LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) into production applications.Experience in a founder-led, growth-stage firm.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer Ruby on Rails
jobs.description:
Role Description:

This role is ideal for seasoned engineers with 8+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining high-scale production systems, with strong expertise in Ruby on Rails and experience working with React.js and/or Angular.



The role focuses on technical leadership, architecture, engineering excellence, and solving complex, ambiguous problems while contributing to the technical direction and engineering culture of the organization.



What You'll Do:

Technical Vision & Architecture: Lead the architectural direction for complex, large-scale systems. You will balance the immediate needs of the business with long-term system health, ensuring our solutions remain simple, scalable, and resilient. 

Engineering Excellence at Scale: Champion disciplined engineering practices (TDD, Pair Programming, CI/CD) across multiple teams. You don't just follow the bar; you raise it by introducing better patterns and tooling. 

AI Strategy & Mentorship: Drive our AI-native development model. You will experiment with and define how we use AI to accelerate the SDLC, ensuring the team uses these tools to enhance—rather than replace—deep technical judgment. 

Cross-Team Leadership: Act as a force multiplier. You will mentor senior engineers, conduct high-impact code reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning and craftsmanship. 

Strategic Client Partnership: Work as a technical consultant for high-stakes client engagements, translating vague business goals into robust technical roadmaps and navigating complex stakeholder environments. 

Systemic Problem Solving: Beyond resolving production issues, you identify class-level problems in our infrastructure or codebase and implement systemic changes to eliminate them permanently. 

What We're Looking For:

8+ years of experience building and maintaining high-scale production systems. 

Mastery of Fundamentals: Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, functional programming, and system architecture (Microservices, Event-driven, etc.). 

Polyglot Mindset: High proficiency in Ruby on Rails and React/Angular, with the proven ability to architect solutions across multiple tech stacks (Python, Go, etc.) as needed. 

Influence without Authority: Demonstrated ability to lead through persuasion and technical excellence rather than just hierarchy. 

Advanced AI Collaboration: Deep experience integrating AI into a professional workflow to explore architecture, automate toil, and peer-review logic. 

Proven Ownership: A track record of taking a project from a nebulous idea to a successful, maintained production system. 

Communication: Exceptional ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. 

Clear thinking and strong problem-solving ability, with the capacity to break down complex problems into simple, well-structured solutions.

A strong sense of ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, care deeply about quality, and are not comfortable shipping work that does not meet your standards  

What We Offer:

100% remote workHigh-impact projects & learning environment

Joining Preference:

Open to candidates who can join at the earliest.

Work Environment:

Remote-first, collaborative culture with flexibility, accountability, and continuous learning, plus occasional in-person meetups.

Company Description

At Carmatec we believe that Digital Transformation of businesses requires the best-of-the-breed technological enablement which is not possible without the most leading-edge talent. By working for a global clientele, we, at Carmatec, build our world of advanced technology which is designed for the people, by the people and brings the best of the ‘Human’ and ‘Digital’ closer. We are learning & growing every day to invent new ways of working and making things more pleasant for employees & more profitable for customers. To undertake all these growth initiatives, our team is growing continuously. Passionate to join us in our journey of innovation? We invite you to discover the jobs we offer.



Job Description

Carmatec is looking for passionate Ruby on Rails Developers to be a part of our Rails Carma team (www.railscarma.com) . Not only will you have the chance to make your mark as an established Ruby on Rails Developer, but you will also get to work and interact with seasoned professionals deeply committed to revolutionize the ROR development scenario.


Job Description


Understanding of software design and architecture
Design and develop software solutions using Ruby on Rails
Analyze client’s requirements and prepare technical specifications for implementations.
Complete tasks based on the plan, requirements and schedule approved by the manager.
Develop product and its elements as per specifications received from the client
Work with QA team to monitor and resolve reported problems and bugs at the project level
Establish and comply to performance metrics at team level
Work with QA Leads & Testers to improve code quality and adherence to project schedules
Estimate tasks, define detailed schedules, evaluate technologies, develop prototypes, Contribute to design issues
Ensure that projects are completed to a high quality standard, on time and on budget
Maintaining good documentation of tasks status
Schedule and prioritize the tasks of a small team to promote efficient use of time and maximize productivity.
Monitor progress against schedule.
Determine when additional initiative is required to meet scheduled work and proactively undertake it.


Qualifications

Required Skills


2-5 years of overall experience in developing ruby applications.
Analyse, design, develop and support complex applications.
Designing and developing complex modules in Ruby on Rails.
Should have strong knowledge in Restful architecture in implementing APIs and using third party APIs in rails application.
Clean sheet Relational Database Design together with very good SQL skills.
Working knowledge of JQuery, Prototype, Ajax and Libraries.
SVN or Git version control and Rake/Capistrano Experience.
Experience in Agile Development, TDD/TFD and testing tools


Additional Information



Experience: 2-5 years

Location: Bangalore

Champion best practices in software development and agile methodologies.## Qualifications  A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in backend or full-stack software engineering. Demonstrated success in building and scaling products that cater to a large user base (thousands of monthly active users).  Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.  A strong sense of ownership and a proactive, initiative-driven approach to problem-solving. Bonus: Experience working with globally distributed and remote teams.## Our Commitment to You We believe in fostering a supportive and growth-oriented environment for our team members. An annual in-person gathering for team building, connection, and celebration.
